product_metadata.title: KOUFALL Blue Short Curtains 36in Long for Basement Windows Small Pair Rod Pocket Semi Sheer Faux Linen Tier Cafe Curtain RV Summer Drapes for Camper Bathroom Kitchen 30x36 in Length Light Aqua Blue
features: LIGHTWEIGHT & LINEN LOOK: The lightweight fabric makes the tier curtains sheer enough to filter in soft light, but still tightly woven with subtle texture complementing a stylish linen look.
SLUB SEMI SHEER: Blended with special thicker and brighter threads, these curtains display a perfect sheer-meets-burlap look with a whisper of sheen, creating a collision between rustic and delicate.
2-WAY HANGING OPTIONS: Hang these tier cafe curtains (1) from the 2-inch rod pocket for a classic look, or (2) using clip rings for easy, slide open and closed (clip rings are not included).

SERVE WELL: Cover the lower portion of your windows to provide privacy or used alone on shorter length windows. Perfect for kitchen, infant room, kids room, nursery, bathroom, laundry room, basement, hallway or any small windows.

EASY CARE & SET INCLUDES: 2 tier curtains in package, each panel measures 30"W x 36"L; set measures 60"W x 36"L, valance sold separately. Machine washable in cold water, do not bleach, tumble dry low, iron on lowest setting if needed. Easy use of easy care.
